structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "מניות" track (קופה 8522). It showed the biggest return I saw, 24.04% over 3 years, it's a name I know, and the fee is 0.55%, about the same as all the others. I'm only fairly sure, because I never got past the first few companies.

stuck.why: I couldn't see which chip was selected, and none of them said קופת גמל להשקעה. I went by the 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' link and guessed the list underneath was that product.

stuck.where: The track list, from about screen 9 on
stuck.why: 143 tracks, and every card looks the same: 0.5-0.7% fee, 0% from deposits, two coloured percentages. After about 5 companies I stopped telling them apart, and I'd have closed the page around screen 18.

stuck.where: Return lines that say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים'
stuck.why: A lot of the cards have no number in that spot, so I couldn't compare them. I just skipped those.
The S&P was the thing I came looking for, but Harel's 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' showed 13.7%, while plain 'מניות' showed 24.04%. So I went with the bigger number, even though I'm not sure that's smart.

used: Intro first lines: no tax inside, can withdraw any time
Summary line 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.5% עד 0.73%'
מור 'מניות' 22.48%, אנליסט 'מניות' 20.9%, אלטשולר שחם 'מניות' 19.22%, for comparison
skimmed: Intro paragraphs about the law, age and moving the money to a קצבה at 60
Bond/credit tracks (אשראי ואג"ח, אג"ח סחיר, כספי שקלי)
The מניות / מט"ח percentages next to the rings
skipped: Search box and the 'במה הכסף מושקע' / 'מיון' dropdowns
'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' link (I didn't open it)
unsure_meaning: מט"ח percentage: I couldn't tell what 99% מט"ח on the S&P track means
The yellow vs. teal ring: my guess is teal = shares, yellow = foreign currency
'ההפקדות 0%' vs 'מהחיסכון 0.55%': I think there's no fee on deposits, but I'm not sure
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a number
Whether 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת 24.04%' means per year, so 3 years is about 72%
Whether the list is really קופת גמל להשקעה or the 182 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' chip
not_found: A clear 'קופת גמל להשקעה' product label among the chips
Any fee in shekels for an amount like 30,000 ₪
Any recommendation or 'best for beginners' marker
How to actually open one / a join button
Where the big names like מגדל / כלל / הפניקס sit in the list (didn't reach them)

findings.what: The list is far too long: 143 near-identical cards on 40 phone screens, with nothing that helps a beginner narrow it down
Many cards show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where the return number should be, so they look empty and can't be compared
I can't see which product chip is selected. The page talks about קופת גמל להשקעה but no chip has that name
Fees only appear as percents. Nothing says what 0.55% means in shekels for my money
The two-colour ring and the 'מט"ח' percentage aren't explained next to the ring
The large return numbers push you toward whatever did best lately, and there's no warning on the card
There's no next step or button for how to join
